quotes.text: Add support for Cash App Pay to your integration.
This article has multiple variants. Fetch one of the following URLs to view specific content for your use case:

old_evidence.text: An authentication session expires after 60 minutes. You can refresh the QR code up to 20 times before the PaymentIntent’s status transitions back to `require_payment_method`.

For test [manual capture](https://docs.stripe.com/payments/cash-app-pay/accept-a-payment.md#manual-capture) PaymentIntents, the uncaptured PaymentIntent auto-expires 60 minutes after successful authorization.

findings: Semantic delta: the 2026-11-07 raw lines 9-21 replace the detailed May 7 capture with seven variant links: Checkout, Elements/Checkout Sessions, Elements/Payment Intents, Direct API, iOS, Android, and React Native. The new page itself contains no integration fields, timing, compatibility, SDK, authentication, capture, or outcome text. The diff lines 1-14 and 2542-2550 show removal of old body and addition of navigation, not proof of changed behavior; diff line 2542 has concatenated old-final/new-first text, so the raw files are controlling evidence.

Baseline summary error: current source lines 13 and 21-23 call the 60-minute period an authorization window and state one 7-day manual-capture window. Old raw lines 1132-1144 and 1404-1416 describe a 60-minute authentication session, while old raw lines 1146-1176 describe manual capture after authorization and a 7-day window for web PaymentIntent paths. Old raw lines 2512-2518 separately state a 60-minute auto-expiry for test React Native manual-capture PaymentIntents, in conflict with the adjacent old raw lines 2446-2476 seven-day capture account. These are historical internal scope/conflict issues, not new changes.

Baseline route omission: current source lines 13 and 17 and Stripe index line 398 omit React Native although old raw lines 2203-2212 and new raw lines 18-21 explicitly include it. Current source lines 25-27 also select Direct API and iOS details without clarifying the distinct Elements, iOS, Android, and React Native paths. Root index line 7 routes via Stripe index line 398; stripe-wallets concept lines 133-154 and 405 repeat the broad timing/route claims, so that concept needs corresponding scoped correction if source is corrected.

Outcome boundary: old raw lines 1013-1022 and 1040-1066 require inspecting PaymentIntent status after return; old raw lines 1194-1198 prefer payment_intent.succeeded events over client callbacks. Old raw lines 1226-1234 and 1575-1583 allow declined or timed-out attempts despite live-mode redirect wording at old raw lines 1214-1224. Thus current source line 29 and stripe-wallets line 153 overstate live auto-approval if read as payment success. The 2026 index makes no current success claim.

Old raw lines 16-32 give US/USD and Checkout modes; lines 171-175 distinguish a Checkout Session from a PaymentIntent at lines 654-699 and Direct API lines 1247-1294. Old raw lines 2347-2355 make a custom URL scheme an iOS-specific React Native return requirement. Older version values at lines 254-277, 1623, and 1954-1973 are dated and cannot be refreshed from the new index.
historical_claims_to_preserve: Preserve dated May 7 detailed instructions and their raw provenance at current source lines 4-8 and 31-33: Checkout USD/modes (old raw lines 16-32), the variant-specific browser, server and mobile flows (old raw lines 134-140, 635-639, 1247-1255, 1596-1604, 1927-1935, 2203-2212), and manual capture (old raw lines 1146-1176). Label them historical, since new raw lines 9-21 are navigation only.

Retain old raw lines 1138-1144 authentication-session and QR refresh detail with that label, distinct from a capture hold and from the 10-minute requires_action failure text at old raw lines 1230-1234; do not flatten these periods into one guarantee.

Retain old raw lines 2514-2518 React Native test manual-capture 60-minute expiry alongside old raw lines 2446-2476 seven-day text as an unresolved internal contradiction. Do not assert one universal capture deadline.

Retain old raw lines 1194-1198 event/status advice and lines 1226-1234 failed-payment possibilities against the old live-mode redirect language at lines 1214-1224. An automatic in-app approval description is not a merchant success or settlement guarantee.
conflicts: Old React Native section says seven-day capture at raw lines 2446-2476 but test manual-capture PaymentIntent auto-expires after 60 minutes at raw line 2518; current source lines 13 and 23 and stripe-wallets line 153 incorrectly present seven days as universal.

Old raw lines 1138-1144 and 1408-1416 say authentication session expires after 60 minutes, while failed-payment sections at old raw lines 1230-1234 and 1579-1583 say requires_action customers must finish within 10 minutes after redirect. These must be preserved as scoped, unresolved historical timing statements.

Current source line 29 and stripe-wallets line 153 say live mode auto-approves after redirect, but old raw lines 1226-1234 and 1575-1583 document decline and incomplete-action failures; narrow the statement to the old guide's lack of a manual in-app approval control, without treating redirect as success.
unresolved_questions: The linked 2026-11-07 variant bodies were not part of this pin; their current fields, timing, eligibility, SDK versions, and behavior cannot be resolved from the index at new raw lines 9-21.
The old React Native seven-day and test 60-minute manual-capture statements conflict internally (old raw lines 2446-2476 and 2518); the index offers no resolution.

findings: Append the 2026-11-07 raw as a dated variant index without replacing May 7 detail (new raw lines 9-21; current source lines 4-8, 31-33).

Correct pre-existing baseline scope at current source lines 13, 17, 21-23, and 29: add React Native, call 60 minutes authentication-session duration, distinguish seven-day manual capture from the old React Native test 60-minute contradiction, and qualify live redirect/approval against failure and status evidence (old raw lines 1138-1148, 1226-1234, 2203-2212, 2446-2476, 2518).
conflicts: Old React Native manual-capture window conflict at raw lines 2446-2476 versus 2518; old authentication session 60-minute versus requires_action 10-minute statements at raw lines 1138-1144 and 1230-1234.
source_assessments.reason: New capture requires provenance/navigation update; independently, fully read older raw reveals material baseline timing, route, and outcome overstatements in the mapped current source.

answers.Q1: At https://docs.stripe.com/payments/cash-app-pay/accept-a-payment, the November capture establishes a Cash App Pay integration router with Checkout, Elements via Checkout Sessions or Payment Intents, Direct API, iOS, Android, and React Native links (new raw lines 5-21), but no current variant instructions, prerequisites, resource states, or success guarantee. The May 7 capture supplies dated US/USD Checkout eligibility and modes (old raw lines 16-32), server-created Checkout Sessions or PaymentIntents with client handoffs (old raw lines 171-175, 654-699), authentication and status/event boundaries (old raw lines 1013-1022, 1130-1198), and distinct mobile SDK paths (old raw lines 1596-1604, 1927-1935, 2203-2212). The mapped source-stripe-cash-app-pay-accept-payment.md summarizes those older details but omits React Native and overgeneralizes authentication and capture timing at current source lines 13-29.
answers.Q2: At https://docs.stripe.com/payments/cash-app-pay/accept-a-payment, the substantive captured change is presentation/navigation: a seven-route index (new raw lines 9-21) stands where the dated detailed variants appeared (old raw lines 16-32, 635-639, 1247-1255, 1596-1604, 1927-1935, 2203-2212); the diff does not establish changed payment behavior. source-stripe-cash-app-pay-accept-payment.md should retain May 7 instructions and add November provenance while correcting baseline overstatements at current source lines 13-29. The older 60-minute authentication session, 10-minute requires_action language, seven-day manual-capture account, and React Native test 60-minute auto-expiry require scoped reciprocal warnings (old raw lines 1138-1148, 1230-1234, 2446-2476, 2518). Versioned Stripe.js/native SDK examples, server versus client objects, mobile versus desktop returns, and live redirect language remain dated; none proves current eligibility or a successful PaymentIntent, capture, or settlement.
